Typo fix.

```suggestion
| `displayed_items` | `All`           | Choose which item to display. Possible values [`All`, `Profile`, `Region`] |
```
I think it can be a little clearer that this function returns a tuple of `(profile, region)`, either by using named values or with a comment.

Not a big deal, but right now it looks like we get environment variables that may or may not be used.
Would it be possible to structure it in a way that we check `config.displayed_items` before retrieving the necessary environment variables?
